verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents an official Command-Line Interface for scripted installation, configuration, session start and silent removal, aimed at automation and integration with other systems. Its scope is mostly deployment and connection; account and session-data management sits in the separate REST API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, CLI coverage beyond install/config/connect (e.g. querying clients or sessions, machine-readable output for agent workflows).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The AnyDesk Command-Line Interface (CLI) allows advanced users and IT administrators to automate installation, configuration, connection, and removal tasks.
You can start a session using CLI parameters. This is useful for automation or if you're integrating AnyDesk with other systems.
For automated or script-based removal without user interaction, use the --remove parameter.
